name: Hack the Valley
organizer: Hack the Valley (student-run, University of Toronto Scarborough)
participants_note: 404 registered on Devpost; the organizer planned for about 500 builders.

prizes.name: 1st Place Prize
prizes.reward: VR headset plus sponsor subscriptions and credits

prizes.name: JT Award for Future Impact
prizes.notes: Funded by one of the judges for projects with a strong vision of real-world impact.

prizes.name: Best Future of our Planet Hack
Best Beginner Hack
prizes.notes: At least half of the team must be first-time hackers.

prizes.name: Best UI Hack Sponsored By Conrad Mo
EY Data Integration Challenge
prizes.reward: Interview with a banking team plus swag
prizes.notes: Map one dataset onto another without losing data; judged on functionality, usability, innovation and documentation.

prizes.name: SDGs@UofT AI for Inclusive Futures Challenge
prizes.notes: No winning project page names this prize; it may not have been awarded on Devpost.

prizes.name: [MLH] Best Domain Name from GoDaddy Registry

prize_count_note: CAD 2,500 in cash plus hardware and sponsor prizes. Every team is considered for the top three; other categories are opt-in on the submission.

criteria.label: Technicality and quality
criteria.description: Technical skill, code quality and a working prototype.

criteria.label: Solves a current issue
criteria.description: Meets a customer need, with potential to become a business.

criteria.label: Presentation
criteria.description: Clarity of the written and oral presentation.

criteria.label: Inspiration
criteria.description: How excited the judges are; unique and creative.

criteria.label: Authenticity
criteria.description: Whether the idea is original or has been seen before.

judging.judge_profile_summary: 11 judges: engineers and consultants from banks and consultancies (BMO, RBC, EY, CGI), a networking-company engineer, Dell Technologies staff, a CSE representative and three startup founders.
judging.notes: Four-minute pitch plus one minute of judge questions (technical and non-technical). A project without a linked GitHub repository is not judged.

submission_requirements: Write-up: why, tech stack, what it does
GitHub repository link (required to be judged)
